**REFERENCE**

**Commands, options and configuration**

Full reference · CLI · API · Configuration

**Information**

|                        |                                     |
|------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Document title**  | Reference |
| **Version**            | 1.1 |
| **Last updated** | 12/11/2026 |

## 1. General usage

```
npx flipova-design <commande> [options]
```

Arguments in square brackets are optional. Without a recognized command, the tool lists the available commands.

## 2. Commands

| **Command** | **Role** | **Example** |
|--------------|----------|-------------|
| `init` (alias `inject`) | Injects the application wiring, never overwriting (`--force` to overwrite). | `npx flipova-design init` |
| `adopt` | Copies the registries into the application, which becomes the owner of its design. | `npx flipova-design adopt` |
| `gui` | Local web editor for the registries. | `npx flipova-design gui --port 4000` |
| `gen` | Compiles the registries to `theme/`; `--check` fails on drift; `--list` lists the files. | `npx flipova-design gen --check` |
| `check` | Determinism rules and XSD validation; `--list-rules` lists the rules. | `npx flipova-design check` |
| `verify` | Checks that the committed canonical index matches the registries. | `npx flipova-design verify` |
| `canonical` | Computes the canonical index. | `npx flipova-design canonical` |
| `lint` | Validates each registry file against the XSD. | `npx flipova-design lint` |
| `pipeline` | Chains gen, check, verify and lint. | `npx flipova-design pipeline` |
| `where` | Shows the resolved paths (diagnostics). | `npx flipova-design where` |

## 3. Options

| **Option** | **Type / values** | **Default** | **Description** |
|------------|--------------------|------------|-----------------|
| `--port` | integer (`gui`) | chosen automatically | Port of the local editor. |
| `--no-open` | flag (`gui`) | off | Does not open the browser. |
| `--check` | flag (`gen`) | off | Fails if the generated files have drifted. |
| `--list` | flag (`gen`) | off | Lists the files produced. |
| `--list-rules` | flag (`check`) | off | Lists the check rules. |
| `--force` | flag (`init`) | off | Overwrites the injected files. |

## 4. Configuration

**Package subpaths**

| **Subpath** | **Contents** | **Required** |
|-----------------|-------------|-----------------|
| `@flipova/foundation` | Unified components, `FlipovaProvider`, hooks | Yes |
| `@flipova/foundation/ui` | Unified components, `createUi`, `coverageOf`, `componentsOf` | No |
| `@flipova/foundation/contract` | Types and recipes | No |
| `@flipova/foundation/providers` | Core of the providers | No |
| `@flipova/foundation/providers/flipova` | flipova provider (57 components) | No |
| `@flipova/foundation/providers/gluestack` | gluestack adapter | No |
| `@flipova/foundation/providers/gluestack/ui` | Full gluestack catalog | No |
| `@flipova/foundation/providers/paper` | react-native-paper adapter | No |
| `@flipova/foundation/providers/tamagui` | tamagui adapter | No |
| `@flipova/foundation/providers/reusables` | reusables adapter | No |
| `@flipova/foundation/tokens` | Design tokens | No |

**Properties of `FlipovaProvider`**

| **Property** | **Role** | **Default** | **Required** |
|---------------|----------|------------|-----------------|
| `adapter` | Component provider to use. | — | Yes |
| `mode` | `light`, `dark` or `system`. | `light` | No |
| `variant` | Theme variant. | default theme | No |
| `theme` | Generated theme (`designTheme`). | the package's neutral theme | No |

Hooks: `useResolvedTheme`, `useAdapter`, `useProviderName`, `useComponents`.

**Optional dependencies**: `react-native-paper`, `@tamagui/core`, `@rn-primitives/switch`, `nativewind`, `lucide-react`, `expo`, `expo-glass-effect`, `react-dom`.

## 5. Exit codes and errors

| **Code / message** | **Meaning** | **What to do** |
|--------------------|-------------------|---------------|
| 0 | Success. | — |
| non-zero | Command failed, a check failed or unknown command. | Read the message: it names the file or the rule at fault. |
| `missing role` | A theme lacks one of the 27 required color roles. | Add the role in the Themes tab of the interface or in `themes.xml`. |

## 6. Examples

Compile, then check that nothing has drifted:

```bash
npx flipova-design gen
npx flipova-design gen --check
```

Check all the tooling at once:

```bash
npx flipova-design pipeline
```

Edit the theme without opening a browser automatically:

```bash
npx flipova-design gui --port 4000 --no-open
```
